cues.text: A new golden image arrives. But a successful build is not yet a trusted production release.
cues.spoken: A new golden image arrives. But a successful build is not yet a trusted production release.

cues.text: BlueOps turns that gap into a controlled journey: build a shared base, prove each workload, then earn the right to promote.
cues.spoken: Blue Ops turns that gap into a controlled journey: build a shared base, prove each workload, then earn the right to promote.

cues.text: The journey starts with a GovTech GCC Golden Amazon Linux 2023 image: a baseline with hardening and some operations agents.
cues.spoken: The journey starts with a Gov Tech G C C Golden Amazon Linux twenty twenty three image: a baseline with hardening and some operations agents.

cues.text: An EventBridge discovery signal is part of the proposed design. Record the immutable source identity before the factory moves.
cues.spoken: An EventBridge discovery signal is part of the proposed design. Record the immutable source identity before the factory moves.

cues.text: Image Builder combines that approved source with approved GCC agent packages and a selected CIS hardening profile. The product is Hardened Base OS.
cues.spoken: Image Builder combines that approved source with approved G C C agent packages and a selected C I S hardening profile. The product is Hardened Base OS.

cues.text: Package-only means no production manager registration baked into the image. Selected controls do not mean full CIS compliance or complete security-scan acceptance.
cues.spoken: Package-only means no production manager registration baked into the image. Selected controls do not mean full C I S compliance or complete security-scan acceptance.

cues.text: Three child families derive directly from that base: GitLab, MongoDB, and CloudOS ECS Worker. The shared base stays in DEV.
cues.spoken: Three child families derive directly from that base: Git Lab, Mongo D B, and CloudOS E C S Worker. The shared base stays in development.

cues.text: GitLab carries its own required runtime. MongoDB is non-container by default. GitLab plus Nextflow is an optional extension, not a fourth core family.
cues.spoken: Git Lab carries its own required runtime. Mongo D B is non-container by default. Git Lab plus Nextflow is an optional extension, not a fourth core family.

cues.text: Now the test floor. Every result must identify the exact candidate. Private connectivity, no public IP, SSM readback, packages, configuration and provenance all matter.
cues.spoken: Now the test floor. Every result must identify the exact candidate. Private connectivity, no public I P, S S M readback, packages, configuration and provenance all matter.

cues.text: For GitLab, demand healthy service, representative clone and push, CRUD, persistence, and reboot proof.
cues.spoken: For Git Lab, demand healthy service, representative clone and push, create, read, update and delete, persistence, and reboot proof.

cues.text: Current private runtime checks cover cold boot and reboot. They do not by themselves prove authenticated repository workflows or a production cutover.
cues.spoken: Current private runtime checks cover cold boot and reboot. They do not by themselves prove authenticated repository workflows or a production cutover.

cues.text: MongoDB needs a running process, CRUD and backup-restore smoke. Those standalone checks do not prove a healthy replica set.
cues.spoken: Mongo D B needs a running process, create, read, update and delete and backup-restore smoke. Those standalone checks do not prove a healthy replica set.

cues.text: A proposed higher-confidence cluster gate would test replication and recovery. Until it passes, cluster readiness remains unknown.
cues.spoken: A proposed higher-confidence cluster gate would test replication and recovery. Until it passes, cluster readiness remains unknown.

cues.text: CloudOS ECS Worker must place tasks on the exact candidate. Zero placed tasks is a failure, even when the image build is green.
cues.spoken: CloudOS E C S Worker must place tasks on the exact candidate. Zero placed tasks is a failure, even when the image build is green.

cues.text: Our proposed demo suite adds mock workloads, service-to-service network flows, and scoped Parameter Store reads through authorized IAM. These are simulated tests, not live evidence.
cues.spoken: Our proposed demo suite adds mock workloads, service-to-service network flows, and scoped Parameter Store reads through authorized I A M. These are simulated tests, not live evidence.

cues.text: Phase A is a controlled release. DEV proof comes first. Only validated child images move toward production acceptance.
cues.spoken: Phase A is a controlled release. development proof comes first. Only validated child images move toward production acceptance.

cues.text: Verify encryption, AMI launch access, and usable backing snapshots and KMS access. A policy observation alone does not prove a successful private launch.
cues.spoken: Verify encryption, A M I launch access, and usable backing snapshots and K M S access. A policy observation alone does not prove a successful private launch.

cues.text: Test the exact image consumed in PROD, with that environment's own agent configuration. DEV success cannot stand in for PROD runtime acceptance.
cues.spoken: Test the exact image consumed in production, with that environment's own agent configuration. development success cannot stand in for production runtime acceptance.

cues.text: The Ops engineer reviews the evidence and gives explicit approval for this rollout. Build success, validation and human approval are separate states.
cues.spoken: The Ops engineer reviews the evidence and gives explicit approval for this rollout. Build success, validation and human approval are separate states.

cues.text: Phase B is a future operating policy. Candidates could build and validate weekly. The proposed promotion window is the first Saturday night each month.
cues.spoken: Phase B is a future operating policy. Candidates could build and validate weekly. The proposed promotion window is the first Saturday night each month.

cues.text: Promotion without per-release Ops approval becomes possible only after management, security and change governance approve that policy and its conditions.
cues.spoken: Promotion without per-release Ops approval becomes possible only after management, security and change governance approve that policy and its conditions.

cues.text: The current repository does not establish unattended monthly PROD rollout. A critical vulnerability can instead trigger an urgent, Ops-approved release.
cues.spoken: The current repository does not establish unattended monthly production rollout. A critical vulnerability can instead trigger an urgent, Ops-approved release.

cues.text: A failed or unknown check, missing approval or policy, missing access, or an unhealthy PROD canary closes the gate. Nothing advances on an assumption.
cues.spoken: A failed or unknown check, missing approval or policy, missing access, or an unhealthy production canary closes the gate. Nothing advances on an assumption.

cues.text: Keep the prior known-good release and a tested data-recovery path. Read back the rollout result. If the canary fails, stop and use the approved rollback plan.
cues.spoken: Keep the prior known-good release and a tested data-recovery path. Read back the rollout result. If the canary fails, stop and use the approved rollback plan.

cues.text: A few minutes of downtime may be acceptable, if approved. Reversibility and observable acceptance matter more than a green build badge.
cues.spoken: A few minutes of downtime may be acceptable, if approved. Reversibility and observable acceptance matter more than a green build badge.

cues.text: Build once. Validate every workload. Promote only what is proven.
cues.spoken: Build once. Validate every workload. Promote only what is proven.
